title: Morrison Lane, Water Mill, NY - Hamptons Real Estate
description:
ttps://www.bespokerealestate.com

Morrison Lane offers a rare opportunity to live at one of the most exclusive waterfront addresses in the United States. This ultra-private property encompasses 2.5 acres of landscaped grounds with approximately 393 feet of water frontage on beautiful Mecox Bay in Water Mill. This estate benefits from a private dock from which residents can effortlessly boat to some of the Hamptons' most notable beaches - namely Scott Cameron Beach, Flying Point Beach, and Mecox Beach. 

Exhibiting outstanding beach-style landscaping throughout, the plot is gracefully adorned with lush green lawns and mature trees that are a delight in each of the seasons. A slightly elevated position helps to capture the scenery perfectly, which is arguably one of the best waterfront views in the Hamptons. 

The current main residence is a stylish beach house, perfectly positioned with multiple second-level terraces that enjoy equally beautiful yet contrasting views over Mecox Bay. The 5,200 SF +/- of living space features two bedrooms, two full and one half bathrooms, and a lower level. Other notable features of this home include three fireplaces, Frank Lloyd Wright windows, and a double height great room. 

The master suite has a spacious sitting room, a large walk-in closet, a full bathroom, Frank Lloyd Wright quartz fireplace, and an outdoor shower area. The second suite has a generous sitting room, a full bathroom, and a large bedroom. The separate guest house comes complete with two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a two-car garage. 

Private yet open to the scenery, the property exudes peace and seclusion; featuring a custom-built stone gazebo with a delightful waterfall, a 50-foot granite swimming pool with a surrounding custom patio, two gated entries with separate parking areas, detailed landscaping, and a meandering path leading down to the beach. 

Those searching the East End for their perfect waterfront residence need look no further; as this highly-exclusive estate represents an extremely rare prospect in one of the most idyllic locations in the Hamptons. This property presents an optimal opportunity for redevelopment, with the chance to expand the existing house, or construct a new residence according to your own vision of an exceptional Hamptons waterfront estate.
